problem.name: Countermeasure schedule under resource constraints
problem.description: Allocate exercise, sleep protection, hydration, and sheltering windows across 4 crew for next 72h, subject to power, crew-time, and module occupancy constraints.
problem.objective: Minimize coupled physiological stress score subject to feasibility
